production.note: Model years 2017 to 2019. Stuttcars: "Model Years: 2017 - 2019". First year: Porsche's "2017 Porsche Models Technical Data" sheet lists the 911 Turbo S (porsche-2017-911-turbo-us-specs). The 992.1 Turbo S followed for model year 2021.

body.note: Spec sheet columns "911 Turbo S" and "911 Turbo S Cabriolet"; the Cabriolet is the open version of the same variant.

configuration.note: Spec sheet: engine type "Boxer, twin-turbo", 6 cylinders

displacementL.note: About 3,800 cc. Spec sheet: "3.8 l", bore/stroke "102 mm / 77.5 mm" (6 cylinders at that bore and stroke give about 3,800 cc).

transmission.note: Spec sheet: "7-speed PDK" (Porsche's dual-clutch); no manual was offered on the Turbo S.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum power output @ engine speed: 540 hp @ 6400 | 540 hp @ 6400 | 580 hp @ 6750 | 580 hp @ 6750" (columns 911 Turbo | Turbo Cabriolet | Turbo S | Turbo S Cabriolet). Stuttcars prints "572 bhp @ 6750 rpm", a conversion, not Porsche's US rating.

weightLb.note: Coupe with the standard (and only) 7-speed PDK, standard equipment. Quote: "Curb weight (lbs): 3516 lbs. | 3671 lbs. | 3527 lbs. | 3682 lbs." (columns 911 Turbo | Turbo Cabriolet | Turbo S | Turbo S Cabriolet). The Turbo S Cabriolet is 3,682 lb.
